plugins.name: linkjolt
plugins.description: Run your LinkJolt affiliate program from Claude: review performance, approve pending commissions, see who you owe, fix sales that did not track and manage affiliate coupon codes.

skills.name: affiliate-coupon-codes
skills.description: Give LinkJolt affiliates their own discount codes so sales using a code are credited to them. Use when the user wants to add, check or list coupon codes for affiliates, or asks why a code is not crediting an affiliate.
skills.description_zh: 为LinkJolt联盟伙伴配置专属优惠码，使使用代码的销售归属该伙伴，支持添加查询列码及归属故障排查。

skills.name: affiliate-program-review
skills.description: Review how a LinkJolt affiliate program is doing, covering sales, commissions, clicks, top affiliates and anything that needs attention. Use when the user asks how their affiliate program, partners or campaigns are performing, wants a weekly or monthly recap, or asks which affiliates are doing best.
skills.description_zh: 评审LinkJolt联盟计划的销售、佣金、点击、头部伙伴和关注项，支持周月总结及伙伴活动表现查询。

skills.name: pending-commissions
skills.description: Go through LinkJolt affiliate sales waiting for approval and recommend which to approve, check or reject, then approve or reject only the ones the user confirms. Use when the user asks about pending commissions, sales to review, what to approve, or suspicious affiliate sales.
skills.description_zh: 审查LinkJolt待批准联盟销售并建议批准、检查或拒绝，仅对用户确认的项目执行批准拒绝。

skills.name: sale-not-tracking
skills.description: Find out why an affiliate sale is missing or wrong in LinkJolt and what to do about it. Use when the user or one of their affiliates says a sale did not track, a commission is missing, a coupon did not credit the affiliate, or a sale shows the wrong status.
skills.description_zh: 排查LinkJolt联盟销售未跟踪、佣金缺失、优惠码未归属或销售状态错误，并建议处理方式。

skills.name: who-to-pay
skills.description: Work out which LinkJolt affiliates are owed money, how much in each currency, what is already on its way, and how to pay them. Use when the user asks who they owe, what payouts are due, how much to pay affiliates, or how to pay their affiliates.
skills.description_zh: 核算LinkJolt应付伙伴及各币种金额、已在途支付和支付方式，回答付款到期和金额问题。
